programme.title: Who is Under MOST PRESSURE in CFP? What’s Next For Michigan? | Others Receiving Votes
programme.desc: Who is Under MOST PRESSURE in CFP? What’s Next For Michigan? | Others Receiving Votes Sports Illustrated's Pat Forde and Bryan Fischer are joined by former longtime College Gameday Reporter Gene Wojciechowski to talk about the biggest stories in College Football. They give a full breakdown of the College Football Playoff First Round, previewing Alabama-Oklahoma, Miami-Texas A&M, James Madison-Oregon and Tulane-Ole Miss. They also discuss which CFP teams and leagues are under the most pressure heading into the postseason and why. Following that, they give their College Football Playoff First Round Betting Picks for every game on the slate and give their opinions on the latest in the Michigan Football Scandal, including what's next for Michigan in their coaching search. Finally, they wrap things up with some discussion about Missouri Head Coach Eli Drinkowtiz's recent comments about the State of College Football and Joel Klatt's NCAA Basketball Tourney Take.
